summary: Intuitive Machines, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of the Goonhilly Acquisition, acquiring all shares of Goonhilly Earth Station Limited (UK) for £37.0 million, split equally between cash and stock (960,649 Class A shares), plus the U.S. COMSAT LLC for a $10 million base cash purchase price with adjustments. The acquisition was completed on August 3, 2026, pursuant to a Share Purchase Agreement dated May 14, 2026. A press release was furnished. No board recommendation or advisors were named in the excerpt. The deal closed immediately, so post-closing adjustments and integration execution are key watch items.
